# czc-v2026.10.28.1 (0.2.18.7)

Admin account connection tests now send `X-OpenCode-Session` for API-key
accounts whose upstream is the official OpenCode host. Previously the test for
an account such as `opencode` (DeepSeek platform,
`base_url=https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1`, `api_protocol=responses`) failed with
`API returned 400: MissingSessionID`, even though real gateway forwarding
already attached the header.

## Changes since czc-v2026.10.27.4

- Responses (`/responses`) account test: API-key accounts pointing at
  `https://opencode.ai` now get the OpenCode session header and the canonical
  OpenCode User-Agent, matching the gateway forwarding path.
- Responses compaction probe (compact test mode): same header and User-Agent
  handling for API-key accounts on the official OpenCode host.
- Anthropic-protocol API-key account test (`/v1/messages`): same handling when
  `base_url` points at the official OpenCode host.
- OAuth test paths and non-OpenCode upstreams are unchanged. Account
  `header_overrides` still decide the final User-Agent; an explicitly
  configured `x-opencode-session` override is still honored.

## VERSION

`0.2.18.7`

## Upgrade guidance and compatibility

- No database migration, configuration update or API key replacement is needed.
- Only admin connection tests change; live forwarding behavior is unchanged.
- Build from this exact tag, rebuild the frontend immediately before the
  `-tags embed` server build, and set `main.ReleaseURL` to this origin release.

## Rollback

Restore the pre-install binary saved as
`/opt/sub2api/sub2api.bak.czc-v2026.10.28.1-<UTC timestamp>` and restart
`sub2api.service`, or rebuild and deploy `czc-v2026.10.27.4` (`0.2.18.6`).
No database or configuration rollback is required. Verify HTTP 200, version
`0.2.18.6` and the previous origin release URL after rollback.
